words.meaning: Large or important. 'There was a significant rise in prices.'
Go up and down. 'Sales fluctuated between 2010 and 2015.'
By a large amount. 'India's figure grew considerably.'
Shows contrast. 'Canada was stable, whereas India grew fast.'
Harmful. 'Too much screen time is detrimental to sleep.'
Make a problem less bad. 'Public transport could alleviate traffic.'
Certainly, cannot be avoided. 'Prices will inevitably rise.'
Many different. 'Cities offer a wide range of jobs.'
Partly. 'I agree to a certain extent.'
Large in amount. 'A substantial number of people work from home.'
As a result. 'Consequently, traffic has fallen.'
